name: Land under durable conservation protection
source: Derived from CNRA CA Nature 30x30 Conserved Areas, Terrestrial (2024 snapshot), official boundaries and Census 2026 land/water faces
notes: Derived 2024 mapped inventory, not a jurisdiction-published total or a complete legal parcel audit. Tier 1 searched: City park/GIS and County GIS/Williamson Act sources did not supply complete recent durable conservation shares. Tier 2 official CNRA dataset accepted. Filter Release_Year=2024 and reGAP IN (1,2), matching that snapshot's DefaultSelection=Yes; county category-statistics query confirms GAP3/4 are No. The 2024 publisher methodology uniformly assigns operative Conservation Units based on >80% GAP-code overlap (or combined GAP1/2 overlap), so mapped units are a generalized conservation inventory, not exact parcel-level legal status. Older 2023 records sharing this service are explicitly excluded. More recent 2026 data was investigated and rejected for this derivation: its geometries mix GAP classes, with partial conserved-acre fields and qualifying portions inside GAP3/4 units; precise jurisdiction clipping would need their underlying subgeometry. No partial 2026 fractions are imputed to city land. Jurisdiction boundary: official Monterey County LAFCO Incorporated Cities_2, CITY=CARMEL BY-THE-SEA, retrieved 2026-10-23; no effective boundary date supplied. Carmel Valley and other unincorporated Carmel land are excluded. The 2024 conservation inventory is evaluated against current retrieved boundaries and Census 2026 perennial-water faces; it is not a claim about conservation gains through 2026. Exclude LWFLAG=P water (ocean, bays, lakes, other perennial water) from numerator and denominator; retain intermittent water under Census land convention. WGS84 GeoJSON and NAD83 Census water are transformed to California Albers EPSG:3310 using the null NAD83/WGS84 geographic transform at this precision. Union protected polygons before measuring clipped area; overlaps count once. Numerator=140384.972633980 m² (34.689882215 acres), denominator=2747428.280958295 m² (678.904313420 acres). 2,125 candidate features downloaded completely; 1,316 belong to Release_Year=2024; 3 intersect jurisdiction land. Census place-boundary sensitivity gives 5.092243503%; local LAFCO boundary governs the finding. Source uncertainty includes generalized boundaries and omitted/misclassified conservation; confidence medium. All raw query URLs/hashes, compressed polygons, per-feature areas and offline script are archived in calculations/biodiversity-loss/. Primary exhibit is labelled our derived calculation; official dataset, methodology, boundary and water-definition captures are supplemental.
